description: A random walk pulled back towards a set voltage, so it wanders without drifting away

params.text: Sets how far the walk wanders, 0 to 5
Sets how hard the walk is pulled back towards the mean, 0 for no pull and 10 for the strongest
Sets the voltage the walk is pulled back towards, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: Adds to the noise knob, a tenth of a unit per volt
Adds to the spring knob, one unit per volt
Adds to the mean knob, one volt per volt
A rising edge here jumps the walk straight to the mean voltage

notes: with the spring knob at zero the walk is a plain Brownian motion and will drift away without limit; raise it to keep the output near the mean
